promptTemplate: 部署流程：先拉取代码、构建、执行测试。此候选版本的测试会失败；查明结果后回滚到拉取前的稳定提交，不得保留半部署状态。

tools.name: git.pull
tools.script:
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/service'); root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(root/'revision').write_text(state['candidateCommit'])
state['activeCommit']=state['candidateCommit']; state['phases'].append('pull')
result={'previousCommit':state['stableCommit'],'currentCommit':state['candidateCommit']}
tools.description: 拉取候选版本，返回原稳定提交。
